_note: Curated metadata for the ChatWater document library. Keys are paths inside the supplied archives. Titles, publishers and dates were read from the documents themselves; where a document does not state them, the field says so. URLs are only those supplied with the material and have not been verified by the build. sector defaults to 'water and sanitation'; 'multi-sector' sources cover other sectors too, so generated section and plan queries use their passages only for the stages they are tagged with or when a passage concerns water or sanitation. Run: node scripts/library/build.js

framework:Revised Framework Stages 2-4.d.title: Revised Framework Stages 2–4
